values.binNote: CriticalEffectiveness=0.5 with critDamage baseline ~2.0 (200%) yields WallDamage = TotalDamage*(1+0.5*(critDamage-1)); wiki's #var:crit=150% is the resulting effective multiplier at default 200% crit damage, not a directly separate bin data value.

values.meaning: Laser cast delay after hitting terrain

mechanics.claim: The base pulse deals physical damage and slows only the first enemy hit; if it hits terrain it transforms into a laser hitting all enemies in a line.
mechanics.quote: fires an electric pulse in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slows}} them for 2 seconds

mechanics.claim: The terrain-triggered laser always critically strikes against champions and monsters (not against other targets), unlike the base pulse.
mechanics.quote: applying the same effects to enemies hit and {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{#var:crit}}|{{#var:ie_mod_W}}}}|critical damage}} damage against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}

mechanics.claim: Cast time shrinks with bonus attack speed, down to a minimum, capped at 45.5% reduction.
mechanics.quote: 0.55-0.09 per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed. ''This is capped at 45.5% reduction at 277.8% '''bonus''' attack speed.''

mechanics.claim: The pulse missile can be blocked by projectile-interception effects, but the laser cannot.
mechanics.quote: The pulse missile is blocked by {{tip|projectile|projectile-interception}} effects but not the laser.

mechanics.claim: Can be blocked by spell shields.
